$comment: Settings of the planning stages (packages/agents). Versioned config, no constants in code. Gem kinds are ids from the data release.

s5.$comment: Calc profiles and tree objective of the endgame build, same as the skeleton's until the product owner sets other ones. Level and passive points come from the data release.

s6.$comment: Calc profiles and tree objective of the progression, same as the skeleton's until the product owner sets other ones. The stage table (acts, level bands, passive points) is derived from the data release; a `stages` list here would override it.

s7.$comment: DEFAULT budget tiers (ascending) and calc profiles, editable by the product owner. Tier ids must match the intake form (apps/web/src/config/intake-defaults.json). The item slots come from the data release.

s10.$comment: Gate inputs of S10. Stat names are PoB output names (pob_bridge/lua/runner.lua; MissingXResist is PoB's resistance still missing to the cap). CombinedDPS is used because FullDPS is 0 for builds without full-DPS groups. The thresholds are empty until the product owner calibrates them for the patch: with no thresholds, G4 and G5 report the missing check instead of passing.
